Maria: Quick heads-up — we're running a 2-week demo sprint to prep the CrossCloud connector listing + a joint webinar with CloudPartner. Need alignment on launch post, benchmark narrative, and inbound routing. 30m sync tomorrow? :calendar:

Alex: @Maria I can do this but need 11am PT instead. We should lock product for quant/latency numbers before the sync.

Maria: 11am PT works for me. @Jordan @Sam can you join? Jordan for benchmarks, Sam for demand gen.

Jordan: I'll bring the benchmark deck. Quick ask — need a sample dataset and traffic profile by EOD so I can run the three configs.

Sam: Adding webinar promo plan: registrant nurture + partner-led demo track. I'll draft the nurture cadence and landing page copy.

Eve: I'll own marketplace listing assets (2 screenshots, 1 GIF, short caption). ETA Wed.

Alex: For inbound lead routing: propose routing marketplace leads to `marketplace@redwood.com` with partner tag, then forward to CloudPartner SDR queue. Draft mapping below. :handshake:

Alex: ```
marketplace -> marketplace@redwood.com -> tag=cloudpartner -> route=CloudPartnerSDR
webinar -> webinar@redwood.com -> tag=cloudpartner,webinar -> route=GrowthSDR
bench-download -> mkt@redwood.com -> tag=bench -> route=EngagedLeads
```

Sam: Looks good. Add UTM params for source=cloudpartner. Denise on SDR to confirm final queue names. @Eve pls add a clear CTA on screenshots ("Try demo" + "Get benchmark").

Maria: I'll schedule the 11am PT sync tomorrow. Agenda: confirm launch date, benchmark highlights to surface, CTA + routing, comms timeline, responsibilities. Notion board: https://notion.so/rw-crosscloud-sprint

DeployBot: Event created: CrossCloud Integration Sprint Sync — Tomorrow 11:00 PT — https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abc123

Jordan: On benchmarks: planning FP16, INT8-QAT, and 4-bit runs. Will produce a perf table + cost delta and include sample prompt set. Expect draft by Wed EOD.

Alex: Great. Next steps recap: Jordan collects traffic sample + runs configs, Eve prepares assets, Sam drafts nurture + landing page, Maria drafts launch post outline. We'll treat the routing mapping above as canonical for the launch and update it after Denise confirms. :rocket:
